items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: So you had a little band with Joe Snider... Oh yeah. Lester Lewis? Yeah. And who else? And Oil Ball.

ctx.x: That wasn't a musician. I thought maybe you had that thing about Snider. No. So you had a little band with Joe Snider you were singing, huh? Yeah. And some other guys. You don't remember who they were? Oh yeah.
Lester Lewis? Yeah. And who else? And Oil Ball. Oh yeah.
Yeah. Now I remember. Yeah. And then what did you do after you played, you gigged around with them? Did you get a steady job anywhere else?
